title: Conformal Data for the $O(2)$ Wilson-Fisher CFT in $(2+1)$-Dimensional Spacetime from Exact Diagonalization and Matrix Product States on the Fuzzy Sphere
summary: We study at zero temperature a microscopic quantum spin-1 model on the fuzzy sphere that realizes the $O(2)$ Wilson-Fisher conformal field theory (CFT) in $(2+1)$-dimensional spacetime at a quantum critical point. Here, we use the fuzzy-sphere regularization as it preserves the full spatial $SO(3)$ rotational symmetry of the CFT, enabling the state-operator correspondence that maps energy eigenstates directly to CFT operators.
